description: Answers "did my last call run?". Lists the most recent tool calls this server received, newest first, with status (running / ok / failed), start and finish times, and a summary of the result -- including calls whose response the client never saw because it timed out. Check it BEFORE retrying an edit that timed out, so the edit is not applied twice. Any tool also accepts an optional requestId: a retry with the same requestId returns the first result instead of running again. Read-only; makes no Premiere request.

mutatingOnly.description: Only calls that can change the project

sinceSeconds.description: Only calls started within this many seconds

name: get_recent_calls
